grammarRule.formula: I have a reservation under the name... / What time is breakfast served?

explanation.ml: ഹോട്ടലുകളിൽ എത്തുമ്പോൾ 'I have a reservation under the name...' (ഈ പേരിൽ എനിക്ക് റൂം ബുക്കിംഗ് ഉണ്ട്), 'What time is checkout?' (ഏത് സമയത്താണ് ചെക്ക്ഔട്ട്?), 'Could we get extra towels?' (കൂടുതൽ ടവ്വലുകൾ തരുമോ?) എന്ന് ആവശ്യപ്പെടാൻ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Hotel Stay & Check-in with clear formula: I have a reservation under the name... / What time is breakfast served?

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 റിസപ്ഷനിൽ സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ: Reservation (റൂം ബുക്കിംഗ്), Complimentary breakfast (സൗജന്യ പ്രഭാതഭക്ഷണം), Room service (മുറിയിൽ ഭക്ഷണം എത്തിക്കൽ), Key card (റൂം താക്കോൽ കാർഡ്).
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 റിസപ്ഷനിൽ സംസാരിക്കുമ്പോൾ: Reservation (റൂം ബുക്കിംഗ്), Complimentary breakfast (സൗജന്യ പ്രഭാതഭക്ഷണം), Room service (മുറിയിൽ ഭക്ഷണം എത്തിക്കൽ), Key card (റൂം താക്കോൽ കാർഡ്).

nouns.definition: An arrangement by which accommodations are secured in advance.
nouns.example: I have a confirmed deluxe room reservation under the name Suresh Kumar.

nouns.definition: A desirable or useful feature or facility of a building or place.
nouns.example: Guests have complimentary access to all hotel amenities including the rooftop gym.

nouns.definition: The management and cleaning of household affairs or hotel rooms.
nouns.example: Please inform housekeeping to provide two fresh cotton towels.

nouns.definition: Given or supplied free of charge.
nouns.example: A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily between seven and ten AM.

nouns.definition: A hotel staff member who assists guests by booking tours, making reservations, and arranging services.
nouns.example: The hotel concierge booked premium front-row tickets to the evening classical concert.

nouns.definition: A printed acknowledgment that payment has been received.
nouns.example: Please print out our final hotel stay receipt for company reimbursement.

traps.question: Select the correct phrase to state an existing room reservation:
options: I have a reservation under the name John.
I have booked a reservation into John.
My reservation is named with John.
traps.explanation: 'I have a reservation under the name [Name]' is standard hotel check-in phrasing.
traps.ruleHint: Hotel Formula: reservation under the name [Name].

traps.question: What does 'complimentary breakfast' mean in a hotel?
options: Breakfast that requires compliments to the chef
Breakfast included free of charge with the room
traps.explanation: 'Complimentary' means provided free of extra charge.
traps.ruleHint: Hospitality Vocabulary: Complimentary = free of charge.

traps.question: How do you ask about departure and checking out?
options: When is checking out going to close?
How much time to checkout room?
traps.explanation: 'What is the checkout time?' is simple, polite, and precise.
traps.ruleHint: Question Rule: 'What is the checkout time?'
